successful_hooks: We spent 6 months building X so you don't have to.
Stop doing Y. Do this instead.
past_campaigns.key_learnings: Short punchy sentences work best. Avoid buzzwords like 'synergy' or 'revolutionary'. Always include a strong Call to Action (CTA).

poor_hooks: I am humbled and honored to...
past_campaigns.key_learnings: Formatting with plenty of whitespace is crucial. Bullet points are effective. Tagging relevant people naturally boosts reach.

brand_voice_guidelines.tone: Direct, authoritative but accessible, slightly contrarian.
brand_voice_guidelines.formatting_rules: Use line breaks heavily. Emojis should be used sparingly (max 2 per post) and functionally (e.g., as bullet points). No hashtags on LinkedIn, max 2 on X.
